content.description: 7-terminal Connector (of Wiring) showing connection points for testing battery voltage. Shows a connector with terminals labeled, including GND and + terminals, with test probes attached.

content.text: (e) Inspect the battery voltage between terminal + and body ground of wiring connector with the ignition switch at ON position.

content.description: 7-terminal Connector (of Wiring) showing connection points for testing speed sensor line. Shows a connector with terminals labeled, including GND terminal, with test probes attached.

content.text: 3. INSPECT SPEED SENSOR LINE TO CONNECTOR
With the ignition switch at ON position, check that there is continuity between terminals f and GND of wiring connector four times per each revolution of the magnet shaft.
